messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — SecureKey Labs wants to co-list our KMS/HSM connector + SSO/SCIM integration on SkyMesh marketplace. Can we align timeline and checklist?
Anuj (SecureKey Labs): Happy to sync. We have an HSM-backed KMS that exposes PKCS#11 and an API gateway for cert auth. SAML 2.0 + SCIM v2 supported.
Olivia: For Solutions — we'll need a sample integration guide, test users, and a small demo app for the marketplace listing. Do we have a preferred test plan?
Ethan: Security checklist: FIPS 140-2/3 attestation for HSM, key rotation docs, attestation/CSR flow, and audit log access. Also verify allowed API scopes and token lifetime.
Maya: Good. Can we split into technical, legal, and marketplace tasks and aim for a joint announcement window of ~3 weeks?
Liam: 3 weeks is tight but doable if engineering + legal get quick turnarounds. Proposed launch target: 2026-04-08.
Zara: Legal note — we'll need logo approvals, a short joint marketing blurb, and an embargo window. Please send copy + assets by EOD next Thu for review.
Anuj (SecureKey Labs): We'll provide compliance certs and logo pack. Also can share a small SCIM attribute mapping example for quick validation:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jdoe",
  "name": { "givenName": "John", "familyName": "Doe" },
  "emails": [{ "value": "jdoe@securekey.example", "type": "work" }],
  "groups": ["engineering"]
}
```
Olivia: Perfect. For the marketplace demo we'll need a minimal Redwood config snippet for the KMS connector (so partners can run locally):
```yaml
kms:
  provider: securekey
  endpoint: https://kms.securekey.example:8443
  auth: cert
  cert_path: /etc/redwood/securekey-client.pem
  key_id: sklab-connector-01
```
Ethan: Add: attestation workflow (quote SAML thumbprint) + support for per-tenant key policies. Also confirm HSM model and FIPS level.
Maya: Action items: 
- [ ] Olivia: integration guide + demo app (due 7 days)
- [ ] Anuj: compliance certs + logo pack (due 5 days)
- [ ] Ethan: security checklist + recommended config defaults (due 4 days)
- [ ] Zara: draft joint announcement + embargo terms (due 9 days)
- [ ] Liam: coordinate marketplace submission slot and PR notes (due 10 days)
IntegrationsBot: Created checklist ticket #INT-4921, assigned to Maya/Olivia/Anuj/Ethan. ETA fields set.
Anuj (SecureKey Labs): Confirmed. We'll start on certs and the KMS demo container.
Olivia: I'll stub the demo repo today and post a link when the first PR is ready.
Maya: Thanks everyone — we'll do a short sync Thu 09:00 PT to unblock blockers. :thumbsup:
Liam: +1. If legal clears embargo we can lock announcement text Friday.
Zara: Noted. I'll review assets as they come in.
Ethan: I'll ping infra for a quick HSM attestation review.
Anuj (SecureKey Labs): Looking forward — will post progress in this thread.
